project.title: Insights on hexavalent chromium (VI) remediation strategies: Metagenomics characterization of abiotic and biotic dual chamber microbial fuel cell
project.description: The performance of dual microbial fuel cells (DMFCs) as alternative promising remediation approaches for biological reduction of hexavalent chromium (Cr (VI)) with instantaneous power generation was evaluated in comparison to abiotic DMFC.
